context: Late morning at the office. Hiroshi stops by Yuki's desk after reviewing the report she submitted yesterday.
purpose: small unexpected recognition — boss-to-subordinate, register stays formal

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 田中さん、昨日の報告書、読みました。
lines.en: Ms. Tanaka. I've read yesterday's report.
lines.style: Composed, neutral, fully controlled. Every word intentional. No volume change.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あっ、お時間取らせてしまって、すみません。
lines.en: Oh — sorry to have taken your time.
lines.style: Reflexive apology surfaces before thought. Small breath on the opening particle. Voice contracts slightly, checking herself mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いや、よく整理されていた。あれは本当に助かりました。
lines.en: No — it was well organised. That was genuinely helpful.
lines.style: Slight softening on 「本当に」 — warmth, for him. Still controlled, still even. The praise is understated, delivered without smile or performance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いえ、そんな…ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Caught off guard. The deflection is genuine, not habitual politeness. The gratitude trails quietly, still processing the unexpected praise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 大変だったと思います。引き続きお願いします。
lines.en: I imagine it was hard work. Please keep it up.
lines.style: Closing note, a hint warmer than the opener but within his register. Each word fully formed. He turns to leave on the final syllable.
